vetSays.line: 🛡️ Rocco, Lucia, Dante and Francisco met them at the door — 4 put down. Rocco, Lucia, Dante, Francisco are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Rocco was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Lucia taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Ivy has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Lucia is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
Lucia: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Rocco, Dante, Francisco, Ivy and Tom met them at the door — 5 put down. Dante, Francisco, Ivy, Tom are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lamia just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dante, Lamia, Tom, Nora and Hassan met them at the door — 5 put down. Dante, Tom, Nora, Hassan are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hassan just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rocco just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dante, Lamia, Tom, Nora and David met them at the door — 5 put down. Dante, Lamia, Tom, Nora, David are hurt.
David: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
Ivy: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Nathan: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big Loud (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
💥 The Pack-leader Big Loud SNAPS! No warning. There never is.
Pack-leader Big Loud hits you for 6.
Pack-leader Big Loud hits you for 4.
Pack-leader Big Loud hits you for 6.
Pack-leader Big Loud hits you for 7.
Pack-leader Big Loud hits you for 6.
The Pack-leader Big Loud falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Big Loud!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Somchai just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nurbol, Somchai and Silas met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Nurbol, Silas are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henrique just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Somchai and Henrique met them at the door — 2 put down. Henrique is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Somchai just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Somchai met them at the door — 1 put down.
